name: Achievement
overview: Achievement in Scripture is ultimately rooted in the work and purpose of God, who predestines all things according to His will, granting believers an inheritance through Christ (Ephesians 1:11). True success and overcoming come through Jesus, who declares Himself the way to the Father and the one who has conquered the world (John 14:6; John 16:33). Confession of Christ and faith in His resurrection are essential for salvation, marking the greatest achievement in a believer’s life (Romans 10:9). While human efforts are observed and tested (Habakkuk 2:1; Jeremiah 28:1), spiritual achievement is grounded in God's sovereign plan and Christ’s victory.
